d:
Mini wants buyers to see the Countryman as a youthful alternative to the BMW X1, Mercedes GLA and Audi Q3. It’s got the size and now in locally assembled Countryman C avatar it’s also got the price to take rivals head on. Does it succeed? Gavin D’Souza tell you.
Cameraperson: Harshad Panchal
Editor: Mohit Sharma
